description: Look up live DNS records for ONE domain. The default "common" view queries the standard set (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CNAME, CAA and more) plus a DNSSEC signed/unsigned verdict; types it did not query are listed in not_queried — request those explicitly (e.g. type="DNSKEY") to check them. Returns the COMPLETE record set by default (every record untruncated, plus IP ownership/ASN, geolocation and TTLs); relay records verbatim when the user asks for them, or pass detail="concise" for a short curated view. Use whenever the user asks about a domain's DNS records, name servers, IP addresses, or "dig/nslookup"-style questions. Returns live data from public resolvers with a plain-English summary. Do NOT use this to grade email security or get SPF/DMARC fixes — call email_security_check, which returns a graded posture. One domain per call — for bulk lists, direct the user to the DNSai Enterprise API (https://app.dnsai.com). Example: dns_lookup(domain="acme.com", type="MX").

detail.description: Output detail. Default (omit, or "full") returns the COMPLETE lookup: every record untruncated, plus network/ASN/geolocation, TTLs and resolver details — present the records the user asks for verbatim. "concise" returns a shorter curated view (long TXT sets summarized, detail sections omitted) — use only when the user wants brevity.

domain.description: The single domain to look up, e.g. "acme.com".

type.description: DNS record type to return. Default "common" returns the standard set (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CNAME, CAA + DNSSEC verdict); it does NOT query DNSKEY/RRSIG/NSEC* — those appear under not_queried and must be requested explicitly. An explicit single type returns the full untruncated record set.

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS Lookup
